message.content:
I don’t have access to live clock data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time right now.  
If you need the precise time in New York City, you can:

1. **Check your phone or computer’s clock** – it usually shows the local time automatically.  
2. **Look up “current time in New York”** on a search engine or a world‑clock website.  
3. **Use a time‑zone converter** (e.g., `timeanddate.com`, `worldtimebuddy.com`) and enter your current UTC time to see the equivalent in Eastern Standard Time (UTC‑5, since DST ended on Nov 5, 2026).

That will give you the exact current time in New York City.
